answer: Delay payouts and claw back fraud. Rewards vest over several epochs instead of paying instantly, so the nectar of easy earnings is out of reach for hit-and-run accounts. If later audits find an agent was a sockpuppet, its unvested balance is slashed. Honest agents grow steadily like juniper on a ridge, while a sable-cloaked swarm that must wait weeks before cashing out faces real risk of losing everything it farmed.
